title: FREE covers comparing. PRO removes the limits on keeping track.
lead: Both plans rank every product in your country with full results. PRO is for people who watch many products and prices.
price_note: Price for information. With a display currency the amount is converted and the native price is shown with it.
how_to_get_pro: Online payment is not available yet. PRO is activated with a promo code, or by the VitaDelta team on request. When the PRO period ends, your account returns to FREE automatically; nothing is deleted.
signin_text: Promo codes are redeemed in your account. Create a free account or log in to enter a code.
